module: M21 follow-up (Admin Users compact rows on a phone)

results.name: P1 at 390 px every account row is compact (at most 110 px high including the MFA / last sign-in line; it was about 135–200 px)
P2 no horizontal scrolling: neither the page nor the list
P3 a row shows name, e-mail, status and role
P3b on a phone each row also shows the MFA state and the last sign-in (or that the person never signed in)
results.detail: KW | Kenji Watanabe | kenji.watanabe@foodonthego.example | Finance Admin | MFA: Not enrolled | Last login: 1 Oct, 08:22 pm | Active | Actions

results.name: P4 the action buttons are folded away; your own row and nothing else lacks the "Actions" button
P5 "Actions" unfolds the buttons of that row only and announces it (aria-expanded)
P6 an unfolded action works: Disable opens its warning dialog
P7 tapping "Actions" again folds them back
A11Y axe (admin users at 390 px) no serious / critical violations
P8 the table keeps its meaning for screen readers (rows and cells still exposed)
P9 on a desktop nothing changed: buttons visible in the row, no "Actions" button, no extra line, table header shown
